title: Switch

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Human interface device that emits a continuous signal

body:
"Toggles between an output of 0.0 and 10.0."

The Switch is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It continuously outputs a signal as long as it is turned on.

Functionality

When placed, the Button is initially in its "off" position. Interacting with the Switch toggles it between its "on" and "off" position. While in the "on" position, the Switch emits a signal of strength 10 from its output port; while in the "off" position, the Switch does not emit a signal. The Switch inherits the color of the wire that is attached to its output port.

Trivia

  • This item was previously called the "SwitchComponent".
